questions.question: The first Regional Rural Bank was established in India in the year:

questions.question: Which instrument was used to detect gravitational waves for the very first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**LIGO**__.

__
 
• **LIGO was used to detect gravitational waves for the very first time**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• LIGO is **Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory.**

 
 
• It is located in** Richland, Washington.**
 
• **In 2015**, scientists detected gravitational waves for the very first time.
 
 
 
• A gravitational wave is an **invisible ripple in space.**
 
• These first gravitational waves occurred when **two black holes crashed into one another.**
 
• The collision took place 1.3 billion years ago. But, the ripples didn’t make it to Earth until 2015.
 
• **Causes of a gravitational wave are:**
 
 
• When a star explodes asymmetrically.
 
• When two big stars orbit each other.
 
• When two black holes orbit each other and merge.

questions.question: Which tissue has heavily thickened lignified walls?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sclerenchyma**__.

__**Sclerenchyma tissue has heavily thickened lignified walls**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Sclerenchyma tissue:**

__
 
• Sclerenchyma support tissue is composed of various kinds of hard woody cells. 
 
• Mature cells are usually dead that have heavily thickened secondary walls containing lignin.
 
• Sclerenchyma cells occur in different shapes and sizes, its two main types are:
 
 
• fibres
 
• sclereids
 
 
 
• Fibres are greatly elongated cells whose long, tapering ends interlock each other thus providing maximum support to a plant.
 
• Sclereids are variable in shape and are present in various tissues of the plant, such as the periderm, cortex, pith, xylem, and phloem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Parenchyma**, tissue is composed of living cells that are** thin-walled**, unspecialized in structure, and therefore adaptable, with differentiation, to various functions.

**Aerenchyma **tissue contains **enlarged gas spaces**.

 
• It is formed either as part of normal development or in response to stress.

**Collenchyma **supports the tissue of living elongated cells with irregular cell walls.

 
• These cells have** thick deposits of cellulose** in their cell walls and appear polygonal in cross-section.

• Instruments in this dance include the **Mori, Kiridi, Tudumu, Dappu and Jodukommulu.**
 
• ***Boda Dhimsa*** and ***Gunderi Dhimsa ***are their types.
 
• Other folk dance of Andhra Pradesh includes **Kuchipudi, Vilasini Natyam, Andhra Natyam, Bhamakalpam, Veeranatyam, Dappu, Tappeta Gullu, Lambadi, Kolattam, Butta Bommalu.**

questions.question: Which one of the following pair is an example of Isobars?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Calcium and argon__.

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• **Calcium and argon are examples of a pair of Isobars**__. Calcium and argon have a mass number of 40. The atomic number of argon 18 and an atomic number of calcium is 20.
 
• Isobars:
 __
 
• These are atoms of the elements having the **same mass number but different atomic numbers**.
 
• They differ in the chemical property but has the same physical property.
 
• Example: argon, potassium and calcium.
 
 
 
• The mass number is the sum of a number of protons and neutrons in an atom of the elements is called the mass number.
 
 
• It is denoted by A.
 
 
 
• The atomic number is the number of proton or electrons in an atom of the element is called the atomic number.
 
 
• It is denoted by Z.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Isotopes: These are atoms of the elements having the same atomic number but a different mass number.

 
 
• The isotopes of hydrogen are Protium, Deuterium and Tritium
 
 
 
• Isotones: These are atoms of different elements having the same number of neutrons.
 
• Isoelectronic: These are atoms/molecules/ ions containing the same number of electrons.

questions.question: Which country ranked first among 97 countries in breastfeeding rate, according to a new survey conducted by the World Breastfeeding Trends Initiative (WBTi)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Sri Lanka__**.

__
 
• **Sri Lanka ranked first among 97 countries in breastfeeding rate, according to a new survey conducted by the World Breastfeeding Trends Initiative (WBTi)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Breastfeeding Trends Initiative (WBTi):**

 
 
• It was **launched **in the year **2004 **by the experts at the Breastfeeding Promotion Network of India which is based in Delhi. 
 
• **120 countries** across the world have been involved in the initiative.
 
• Sri Lanka scored** 91 out of 100 points** and topped the survey.
 
• Sri Lanka was followed by countries like **Cuba, Bangladesh, Gambia and Bolivia. **
 
• **India **was ranked at **78th place** with a score of 45.
